verdict.rationale: OpenTofu is an open-source CLI that users install and run on their own machines via many OS-specific installation methods. It is guaranteed to remain 'truly open source' under the Linux Foundation, with source on GitHub and state stored locally or in a user-chosen backend. Community users report migrating real client projects to it. Missing for 10: the specific license is not named in the evidence, and there is no explicit first-party guide framed as self-hosting or air-gapped operation.
